''See also: [[Traveler Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|[[Travelers]] are individuals possessing a wide array of diverse and often terrifying abilities. They are associated with specific locations known as Territories, such as [[Endross]], [[Helgard]], [[Ornheim]], [[Naraka]], [[Ragnarus the Crimson Vault|Ragnarus]], [[Avernus]], and [[Lirial]]. While some believe the name refers to their capacity for rapid movement between locations, not all Territories support such travel. The specific powers of a Traveler depend on their [[Territory]]; for instance, those from [[Helgard]] or [[Ornheim]] can summon weapons, beasts, or elemental attacks like fire and ice, whereas [[Valinhall Travelers]] are specialized in hunting other [[Travelers]]. Other roles include [[Lirial Travelers]], who focus on mapping and surveying. [[Travelers]] can be physically diverse, ranging from hideous figures with black eyes and worm-infested beards to well-dressed individuals in specific uniforms or even injured, older men. The profession can involve various duties, such as serving as guards—often as a form of punishment for incompetence or political errors—or acting as room guardians. It is noted that [[Travelers]] are frequently psychologically unstable due to the stress of existing alongside alien worlds. A significant phenomenon occurs when a Traveler loses control and becomes an [[Incarnation]]; typically, only one such entity exists per [[Territory]] at a time, as a second would likely result in the death of the [[Travelers]] involved.}}

== House of Blades ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-01-house-of-blades|A Traveler is a specific type of person or role characterized by unique abilities and secrets. These entities possess a thousand powers, many of which are gruesome and terrible, and they can be terrifying to encounter. While a Traveler may own a castle featuring a tall tower, they must also travel through their own Territories in order to grow. This process of traveling requires significant risk, such as when a Traveler captured ten people from [[Myria]]. Furthermore, [[Travelers]] of [[Helgard]] or [[Ornheim]] can summon elemental blasts, weapons, or beasts to destroy their enemies.}}
